metadata.title: Fisher Geometry of Circular Wrapped Normals: Completion and Curvature
metadata.abstract: We determine the intrinsic Fisher geometry of the two-parameter circular wrapped normal family. Although its finite parameters form a cylinder, its metric completion is a disk: adjoining the uniform law extends the Fisher metric to a positive-definite real-analytic metric. The Gaussian curvature vanishes at the added point, is positive nearby, and tends to $-1/2$ as the underlying standard deviation tends to zero. We prove that the curvature has exactly one nonuniform zero radius and exactly one critical radius, the latter a nondegenerate positive maximum. Opposite points sufficiently close to uniformity are joined by a unique minimizing geodesic through the uniform law, so their intrinsic distance is not attained inside the nonuniform family. In contrast, identifying the means of real normal distributions modulo a period retains a complete hyperbolic cylinder with an infinitely distant cusp. Wrapping strictly decreases Fisher information in every nonzero tangent direction, while the information deficit and its fixed-order derivatives are exponentially small as the standard deviation tends to zero. The curvature theorem is proved by convergent series and explicit analytic remainder estimates; numerical figures serve only as illustrations.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 统计度量完备化与曲率分类
analysis.workSummary: 作者确定圆周 wrapped normal 二参数族的 Fisher 几何：有限参数形成圆柱，但添加均匀分布后度量完备化为圆盘，且 Fisher 度量实解析、正定地延拓。新增点曲率为零、附近正，标准差趋零时曲率趋 −1/2；非均匀处曲率恰有一个零半径及一个非退化正极大半径。
techniques: Fisher 信息度量及内在完备化
收敛级数和显式解析余项估计
曲率零点与临界点唯一性
analysis.breakthrough: 揭示 wrapping 与简单地将实正态均值模周期识别的商操作有不同内在几何：后者仍是完备双曲圆柱，前者近均匀的对径点最短路会穿过新增均匀分布。
analysis.limitations: 近均匀点的测地线结论有邻域条件；原非均匀族内距离可能只取下确界而不达到。数值图仅为示意，曲率定理依赖解析估计；不能将局部正曲率理解为全族非负曲率。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露ChatGPT及Codex用于证明探索、起草修订、代数验证代码及LaTeX准备；文稿后经审阅修改，证明计算亦被核查。对应探索、写作、核查及编程计算；并未明确将具体核心曲率定理或构造归于模型。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.37985v1 · PDF第18页 Use of generative AI
